issue_name: Maize Leaf Yellowing (Nutrient Deficiency or Water Stress)
causes: Low nitrogen in the soil makes older leaves turn yellow starting from the tips.
Heavy rainfall and waterlogged soil prevent plant roots from absorbing nutrients properly.
Pests like stalk borers can damage the stem and stop food from reaching the leaves.
action_plan: Add well-rotted animal manure or compost around the base of each maize plant.
Dig shallow trenches between crop rows to drain away standing water.
Drop a small pinch of clean wood ash into the leaf funnels to suppress hidden pests.
prevention_tips: Rotate your maize field with beans or groundnuts next season to naturally add nitrogen to the soil.
Mix plenty of decomposed compost into your soil before planting your next crop.
